analyzed_vuln.description: PackChunkyBytes performs `memmove(swap1 + 1, swap1, nChan-1)` when `Extra == 0 && SwapFirst`. `nChan` comes from `T_CHANNELS(info->OutputFormat)` (fuzzer-controlled via dstFormat). If `nChan` is 0, `nChan-1` underflows (unsigned) to a huge value / negative-size at interceptor boundary, causing the ASan `negative-size-param` crash. The root bug is missing validation that channel count is nonzero before this shift/memmove path.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In cms_universal_transform_fuzzer, attacker controls `dstFormat` passed to `cmsCreateTransform`, which propagates into `info->OutputFormat` used by formatter `ToOutput` in `PrecalculatedXFORM` during `cmsDoTransform`. Trigger requires an output formatter selecting PackChunkyBytes with `SwapFirst` set and `Extra==0`, while encoded output channel count is 0; then processing even one pixel reaches the memmove with size `nChan-1` underflow and crashes.
